artboards.title: State · a draft in the box

annotations.text:
A · THE FOOT (leading)
A third zone on the composer card: the cap's material mirrored at the bottom. Suggestion pills sit left, the connector marks right. One card, one border, one focus ring. Same recipe in graphite, paper and cream oak.

STATES
A mark is a door. Not connected: the connect step opens in the composer's own popover recipe. Connected: the handle and Disconnect. The ⋯ lists every connector as icon · name · state, the machine-chip row idiom.

HOVER · TYPING · B
The tooltip carries the word. With a draft in the box the pills leave, the marks stay and the foot keeps its height.
B · The tray hangs the strip under the card as its own well. Tradeoff: a second edge, and the focus ring stops at the card.

C · LIVE IDEAS (optional, more scope)
One door pill. rex reads the room (the launcher's ideas call already exists) and room-grounded pills replace it. Tradeoff: a live read takes seconds and needs a brain. The static three stay as the fallback.

THE MARKS
Simplified geometry in one stroke weight, currentColor, like the provider marks. Not connected = dim. Connected = body ink + green dot. Needs reauth = amber dot. Fixed order, never sorted by state.
